source_entry_ids: WorldClim v2 global land climate surfaces
mappings.notes: WorldClim v2.1 historical climate data, released 2020; 1970-2000 normals. v1 is a separate edition and has its own 2005 associated paper. Paper describes WorldClim v2; producer's current v2.1 is a later data release within that product family.

source_entry_ids: CRU TS monthly high-resolution gridded multivariate climate dataset
mappings.notes: CRU TS v4.10, current producer release observed 2026-10-31; global land time series 1901-2025. Paper describes the v4 family and initial v4.03 release; CRU TS v3.26 paper DOI 10.1002/joc.3711 is a distinct earlier edition and is not used for this count. The 2020 paper documents CRU TS v4.03; v4.10 is a later continuation of the v4 family.

Current producer family page identifies CHELSA v2.1; the dataset paper is the 2017 foundational CHELSA climatology paper and describes the earlier 1979-2013 release. Keep edition distinction explicit. Paper documents initial CHELSA climatologies v1; current v2.1 uses later inputs and should not be treated as identical data.

source_entry_ids: Global Precipitation Climatology Centre Full Data Monthly precipitation product
mappings.notes: GPCC Full Data Monthly Product Version 2022, covering 1891-2020; product-specific DOI at 0.25-degree resolution. Other GPCC analysis products (Monitoring, First Guess, climatology and daily) are separate products. Paper describes GPCC product family; it predates Full Data Monthly v2022.

source_entry_ids: EarthStat harvested area and yield maps for 175 crops circa 2000
mappings.notes: Monfreda, Ramankutty and Foley 2008 crop-area, crop-yield, physiological-type and NPP maps; circa 2000 at 5 arc-minute resolution. The paper describes the circa-2000 maps; later EarthStat crop products are separate releases.
GLiM v1.0; gridded derivative at 0.5-degree resolution with a companion harmonized global vector map. Paper describes the GLiM v1 map database.

ERA-Interim, 1979-August 2019; discontinued and superseded by ERA5. Keep separate from ERA5 (selected citation top-50 group 1). Exact paper is ERA-Interim-specific; do not substitute the ERA5 paper or counts.

source_entry_ids: MODIS Terra/Aqua annual global land cover type MCD12Q1
mappings.notes: Current producer product MCD12Q1 Collection 6.1 at 500 m annual resolution; primary associated paper describes Collection 5, so count is a base product-family proxy, not a v6.1 exact-release usage count. Paper documents Collection 5; candidate product edition is Collection 6.1 and remains version-distinct.

source_entry_ids: History Database of the Global Environment (HYDE) 3.2
mappings.notes: HYDE 3.2 historical population and land-use allocation maps, 10,000 BCE-2015 CE; version 3.2 paper is product-specific. Paper and producer portal explicitly identify HYDE 3.2.

source_entry_ids: FAO/University of Bonn Global Map of Irrigation Areas (GMIA) v5
mappings.notes: GMIA v5, circa 2005 static map at 5 arc-minutes; v5 technical report is DOI 10.13140/2.1.2660.6728. The older peer-reviewed 2005 development paper describes the original GMIA family and is retained as a separate related paper, not silently substituted for the v5 report count. FAO/Bonn report directly describes v5; it is a technical report DOI and may not resolve as a Crossref/OpenAlex work. The v5 technical report has 89 observed citations, retained only in evidence; report counts are excluded from the associated-paper backlog metric. The older 2005 paper is not substituted.
